subject: Pilot: regional SI PoC for EU/APAC data sovereignty & on-prem gateway
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Thorne <oliver@edgeware.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot: regional SI PoC for EU/APAC data sovereignty & on-prem gateway

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Per our conversation, we think theres a concrete pilot path where Edgeware works with Redwood to validate a lightweight on-prem gateway + VPC-control flow for EU and APAC customers. High level ask: a 4-week technical PoC that demonstrates (1) private endpoint provisioning in customer VPCs, (2) tokenized telemetry with configurable retention, and (3) a fall-back to a certified regional model on Redwoods hosted catalog when local capacity is constrained.

Proposed next steps:
- Edgeware provides a short SOC2/network architecture summary and a rough estimated effort for the gateway adapter (2–3 engineers, ~3 weeks).
- Redwood provides a PoC scope spreadsheet and a sandbox environment with private deployment image.
- Quick alignment call next Tuesday to lock scope and timeline.

Ive attached a draft PoC scope for discussion. Vanessa and Marissa are looped for engineering and partner enablement context.

Attachments: redwood-poc-scope-sheet.xlsx

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
minah@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Oliver Thorne <oliver@edgeware.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWorks Ops <cloud-ops@cloudworks.ai>, Suresh Iyer <suresh@kumo-consulting.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot: regional SI PoC for EU/APAC data sovereignty & on-prem gateway

Hi Mina —

Appreciate the clear outline. Quick answers up front: Edgeware can commit a solution architect + one engineer for a 3-week effort to deliver the gateway adapter and basic automation for provisioning into EU/AU customer VPCs. We will need the sandbox images and any interface docs for the Redwood private control plane.

A couple of clarifying questions:
1) For the tokenized telemetry, does Redwood expect full event-level telemetry or a sampled/aggregated set during PoC?
2) Are we validating persistent KV-cache behavior for long conversational sessions (10k+ tokens) or just short interactions?

I attached a one-page SOC2/networking summary — its high-level but should be helpful for your security team.

Looking forward to the Tuesday sync — will Oliver + Suresh attend.

Attachments: edgeware-soc2-summary.pdf

Best,
Oliver Thorne
Head of Integrations | Edgeware Systems
oliver@edgeware.io
+44 20 7946 0821

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Thorne <oliver@edgeware.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pilot: regional SI PoC for EU/APAC data sovereignty & on-prem gateway

Oliver — thanks for the fast turnaround and the SOC2 summary. Short answers:
- Tokenized telemetry: for PoC we only need sampled event-level telemetry (debug enabled for error cases). Full event capture is out of scope for the initial experiment.
- KV-cache: validate medium-length sessions (up to ~4k tokens) with one stress test for a longer 10k token session so we can observe eviction patterns.

Im attaching a slightly revised PoC scope (minor clarifications) and a PDF on Redwoods private deployment options. Vanessa, can you confirm the sandbox image availability and any hostname/network requirements that Edgeware will need?

Attachments: redwood-poc-scope-sheet.xlsx, redwood-private-deploy-options.pdf

—

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: regional SI PoC for EU/APAC data sovereignty & on-prem gateway

Hi all —

Sandbox images: confirmed. We can provide a prebuilt image and a thin operator for provisioning; related network/hostname requirements are in the attached PDF. For the PoC I recommend we validate both: (A) a Private deployment (customer-managed infra, Redwood control plane via VPC peering) and (B) a Dedicated-ish option (Edgeware uses our container + config but runs in partner-managed region). The clear tradeoffs should be captured in the PoC acceptance criteria so the customer can pick after a single week of results.

On commercial and enablement: Marissa, can you prepare a short enablement playbook for Edgeware (1 pager + checklist) and a training slot for their engineers in week 0? Oliver — if you can share your availability for a 60-minute alignment call Tuesday (Dec 1) 08:00-12:00 UTC that will work for our engineers.

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-options.pdf

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Oliver / Mina —

This looks good from a commercial gating perspective. I want to capture procurement steps now so we dont slow the technical timeline:
- We propose a short MOU to outline scope, responsibilities, and an initial credit allocation for Redwood-hosted sandbox usage.
- Edgeware to confirm rate-card for professional services for the adapter work.
- If both sides are aligned, I will route the MOU for signature (DocuSign link below) and kick off a brief SOW draft.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/tx/ABC-123-EDGEWARE-MOU

Please confirm: (a) Edgeware can provide an estimate by EOD Wed (Dec 1) and (b) Tuesday 09:00 UTC works for the alignment call.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra

rishi_m@redwood.com
